type: ADDENDUM - descriptive/secondary de-confound only; does not change any rule, verdict, run, or stage gate of T38_PREREG.json
approval: Blake Jones via parent agent, ruling t234u, 2026-11-25 10:06:04 PM CT: Yes on the horizon-matched P FLOP control (3 seeds, 2.605 epochs to 9.755e16 FLOPs, cosine ending at 1e-4, ~2 GPU-h): draft and freeze the separate prereg addendum now before any data exists, and queue those 3 seeds to run after T-38 finishes so GPU 0 stays uninterrupted on Stage 2.
data_state: No data for these plans existed at created_ct 2026-11-25 10:06:04 PM CT. Checked: 0 iteration folders whose names contain flopmatch/horizon-matched; 0 TERMINAL.json plan_ids in those names or the three plan ids; 0 LAUNCH_QUEUE.json entries with those ids (before this freeze's later queue insert); 0 t38 driver_state keys; 0 autolaunch-audit.jsonl lines. The only pre-existing file is the t232 staging draft T38_FLOPMATCH_P.DRAFT.json, which is not a run.
purpose: De-confound F-T38-02 (the Stage 1 equal-analytic-FLOPs mid-run partial-val H-P of -0.0240). That mid-run slice compared H at the end of its 4ep cosine (min_lr 1e-4) to P at 65.12% of P's 4ep token/FLOP budget, where P's logged LR was still 3.53e-4. This addendum pre-registers a native P control whose cosine terminates at H's Stage 1 analytic FLOP total.
verdicts: unchanged: the T-38 Stage 1 headline remains the equal-bytes 4ep Welch rule in T38_PREREG.json (KILL already recorded). This addendum never decides PASS/KILL/PARITY/INCONCLUSIVE, never amends ladder_rule or stage3_stop, and never overrides F-T38-02 as a mid-run descriptive curve.

scope.arms: P only (flat ModernGPT), M rung (d=576, L=8, ff=1536, heads=9), same tokenizer and trainer knobs as t38-M-4ep-P except the budget and therefore the cosine horizon
scope.not_in_scope: No H runs, no other rungs, no mid-run partial-val points as the primary metric of this addendum

budget.source: H Stage 1 recorded train_flops on all 5 seeds, equal to analytic_flops_per_token.v1 for H (207,411,840) times Stage 1 tokens_seen (470,323,200)
budget.cosine_formula: if s < warm: lr*(s+1)/warm; else t=(s-warm)/(steps-warm); lr*(min_lr_frac+(1-min_lr_frac)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)))

metric: fwedu32 test bpb_corpus on the full test split (same estimator as the T-38 headline). Validation bpb_corpus is recorded but is not the primary metric of this addendum.

comparison.treatment: the 3 horizon-matched P runs (seeds 13, 21, 34) of this addendum, full-split test bpb_corpus
comparison.control: the 5 already-finished Stage 1 H M-4ep runs (seeds 13, 21, 34, 55, 89), full-split test bpb_corpus; these H numbers already exist and are not re-run
comparison.delta: mean_H_stage1 - mean_P_flopmatch (same sign as T-38: positive = H worse)
comparison.test: Welch two-sample t on the seed-level test bpb values, unequal variances, Satterthwaite df; report the two-sided p and both one-sided p values
comparison.also_report: means, SE_diff, 95% CI, and the n=3 shared-seed subset (13/21/34) as a descriptive paired cut d_s = H_stage1(s) - P_flopmatch(s). The 5-vs-3 Welch comparison is the pre-declared primary of this addendum.

stopping: No early stopping and no futility rule. Cap, thermal, and safety stops still apply. All 3 seeds are run to the frozen FLOP budget.

queue.when: after T-38 finishes, so GPU 0 stays on Stage 2 (and Stage 3 if released) without interruption
queue.mechanism: depends_on t38-M-1ep-H (the last Stage 2 plan). Plans are launchable=false until that dependency is done. If Stage 3 is released, those plans keep lower rank_within / queue_order than the flopmatch plans, so they still run first. If stage3_stop skips L, the flopmatch plans become the next launch_priority=3 items. claimed_by is left unset so autolaunch can flip launchable when the dependency is satisfied, without a code change or server restart.
queue.not_used: depends_on a Stage 3 plan (would never fire if stage3_stop skips L). claimed_by=hold:after-T38 (honored as a hold, but t38_driver does not auto-clear that claim when T-38 ends).

gpu_hours_estimate: about 1.97 GPU-hours (estimate: 3 seeds times 306,278,400 tokens / mean Stage 1 P tok/s 129,761; compile/eval not perfectly linear). Blake's ~2 GPU-h is consistent.
not_affected: T38_PREREG.json remains unedited. Amendment 1 remains in force only for ladder_rule.fit_restriction. Addendum PAIRED remains the reported secondary paired-seed analysis of equal-bytes cells.
draft_history: Staged first as analysis-t38/T38_FLOPMATCH_P.DRAFT.json (launchable=false, not queued) in t232; frozen here after t234u approval, before any flopmatch data existed.
